conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced turned up: a weak Jul-Sep at the Toyota-group counterparty Tokai Rika, plus a sector that sold even a raise today (Koito -6.8%), set against a yen about 5 above Denso's 153 assumption, a sell-side bar cut through October, and an outside chance of a new buyback. The findings net to about -0.1. The scaled number is p_up 47 x abs 3.5 = -0.21; abs is raised above the 2.38 proxy because an H1 revision decision is due and this name's last two equivalent prints moved -6.0% and -10.5%.
bar: IFIS consensus FY3/27 operating profit 515,925m yen against company plan 500,000m (held 2026-07-31), https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6902 (read 2026-10-29). My read is that the company holds about 500bn or moves it slightly, so the guide lands about 2-3% under the street number. There is no sourced H1 consensus.
positioning_check: JPX short register as of 2026-10-28: 0.0% disclosed (no holder at or above 0.5%), change 0.0 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). Margin ratio 信用倍率 14.19 (kabutan, 2026-10-29): leveraged retail is crowded long, which is the setup where a disappointment still finds sellers. No options, no skew. Run-up -3.46% over 20 days and -3.64% over 5. On 10/29 the stock was -1.1% before the release while the Nikkei was +1.2%.

findings.finding: Tokai Rika, a Toyota-group supplier and Denso's closest reporting counterparty, said on 10/28 that Jul-Sep ordinary profit fell 44.3% YoY with OP margin down from 8.3% to 5.9%, and Toyota's August global output fell 5.9% (overseas -7.6%), the second down month. Both point to a weak Q2 for Denso, which needs about 139bn of OP a quarter for the rest of the year to reach its 500bn plan after an 84bn Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When Denso posted a weak Q1 on 2026-07-31 with OP -21.5% and the guide held, the stock fell 10.47% (baseline). At the FY3/26 H1 print on 2025-10-31 OP guidance was cut from 675bn to 651bn and the stock fell 6.02%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Tokai Rika has been public since 10/28 14:40 and Denso is -3.6% over 5 sessions and -1.1% this morning against a rising Nikkei. What is left is whether Denso's own Q2 margin is as bad and whether it changes the guide, which nobody can see until the release.
findings.independence: Toyota August production, https://www.logi-today.com/1005493 (2026-09-30), is a different source and points the same way. Japan domestic output was only -1.7%, which is Denso's largest segment, so this is mixed.

findings.finding: Denso set its Q2-onward FX assumption at 1 USD = 153 yen and 1 EUR = 180 on 2026-07-31. The dollar has traded around 158 through October (157.92 on 10/29 per kabutan), which gives a translation tailwind that supports holding or raising the 500bn OP guide toward the 516bn consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-07-31 an FX- and volume-driven revenue raise with OP held still saw the stock fall 10.47%. An FX-only raise has not been rewarded at this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The FX move is public and the IFIS consensus already sits 3% above plan, so much of it is in the street number. The unpriced part is whether management books it or keeps it as a buffer against material costs. If it were fully priced, the consensus would have moved up through October; it has been flat for four weeks.
findings.independence: Yen level 158 per Kumamoto Nichinichi / Kyodo FX reports, e.g. https://kumanichi.com/articles/2049242 (October 2026).

findings.finding: Auto parts sold off on results this week. Koito fell 6.8% on 10/29 (2508.5 to 2338.5) after raising its FY ordinary profit 3% and its dividend by 6 yen, and Tokai Rika fell 3.1% after holding its plan, on a day the Nikkei rose 1.2%. Denso's margin ratio is 14.19, so leveraged longs are crowded.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Denso's last four equivalent reactions were -6.02 (2025-10-31), -1.39, -1.96 and -10.47 (2026-07-31), so this name has sold its prints, including one with the OP guide held.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a reaction-function finding, not a fact about Denso's numbers. Peers selling their own good news today says a hold or a modest raise may not lift the stock. If the market were positioned for relief, Koito would have held its raise.
findings.independence: Koito's raise and dividend increase, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7276 (2026-10-28 15:00). Tokai Rika price, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6995.T?range=10d&interval=1d. Both peers come from one price source.

findings.finding: The sell side cut its bar into the print. A US major bank downgraded Denso to underweight with a 1,700 yen target on 2026-10-14, and two Japanese brokers cut targets on 10/6 and 10/7, after a run of cuts since April. A held guide could read as relief (悪材料出尽くし) against lowered expectations.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior case. After the July cut the stock still fell 10.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The downgrades are public and partly in the -3.5% 20-day run-in. The IFIS earnings consensus has not moved in four weeks (581.8bn pretax at 10/28, 1 week and 4 weeks ago), so the target cuts are on multiple and caution rather than numbers, and that leaves room for a held number to surprise relative to tone.

findings.finding: Denso announced a 450bn yen, 280m-share buyback at its H1 print on 2024-10-31. That frame expired 2025-10-27, and since then it has run only the 313.6bn self-tender that absorbed Toyota Industries' stake (completed 2026-06-02). A new open-market frame at this H1 print is possible but unsignalled, and the cancelled spark-plug sale removes 180.6bn of expected proceeds.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2024-10-31 H1 print with the 450bn buyback: about +2.61% in the baseline's estimated-cadence history (2024-10-30 row). Snippet-level evidence.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody expects a buyback straight after a 313bn tender, so an announcement would be unpriced. That is also why the probability is low and the size is a probability-weighted small number. snippet_only: the EDINET PDF downloaded, but its fonts could not be decoded in this container.
findings.independence: Self-tender completion, https://www.gyokaidigest.com/disclosures/6902-tdnet-20260602-140120260602559201 (2026-06-02). Spark-plug price 180.6bn from Niterra's extraordinary report, via search snippet.

findings.finding: Denso itself asked to cancel the 180.6bn spark-plug and exhaust-sensor sale to Niterra (notice of 2026-10-02). The notice gives no P&L impact for Denso, so a termination cost or a re-plan could show up at H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history on this line. Niterra rose on the cancellation (kabutan 2026-10-05).
findings.why_not_priced: No amount is disclosed, so the market cannot price a cost it cannot see. It is small against a 500bn OP base, and anything below operating income is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Kabutan / Minkabu report, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6902&b=n202610020984: Niterra says the impact on its own forecast is minor. Denso's side is unstated.

release_time_source: Kabutan lists Denso under 取引時間中の発表 for 10/29 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6902&b=n202610281205). The Q1 release on 2026-07-31 came at 11:20 JST (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6902&b=k202607310010). Either way it lands before 15:30, so the window starts at the sealed spot of 1786.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: Denso has revised at every October print since 2021 (kabutan 修正履歴); OP plan 500bn against IFIS 516bn; yen tailwind against material-cost and memory-price headwinds; I expect a hold or a small change. Returns: dividend plan 74 yen (+7), set; a new buyback after June's 313bn tender is possible but unsignalled. New-year guide: n/a, this is H1. Quarter: Q1 NP progress 17.8% against a 5-year average of 23.6%; with a Q2 near last year's 104bn, H1 OP would be about 188bn, 38% of plan, in line with last year's H1 share of the FY actual.

rejected_candidates.detail: Folded into the sector reaction-function finding; it is the same sector-sentiment fact and already in the -3.5% run-in.

rejected_candidates.detail: The material-cost headwind is the same mechanism as the weak-Q2 counterparty finding and the guidance-hold case; merged rather than counted twice.

baseline_tension: The findings roughly offset and agree mildly with the negative priced lean (-0.40, driven by margin overhang). The strongest positive the release could carry is a guide held or raised on FX plus a new buyback; I looked for both, and the buyback has no signal. The negatives rest mostly on public peer data and the sector's reaction, so I did not lean hard.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on series the market already has): the weak-Q2 counterparty finding rests on public data (Tokai Rika's release, Toyota production), so it was cut from -0.6 to -0.4 and p_up moved from 45 to 47.
Rule 2 (check the sign): the draft already had three positives against three negatives, and the strongest positives (a held or raised guide, a buyback) were searched. Nothing else moved.
